# The fixture registry of the G-10 probe: a registry that breaks one rule per entry, so the
# probe has to report every one of them. The rules it breaks:
#
#   * `:g10_flag_enabled` is a feature flag read with a default that turns it on;
#   * `:g10_release_flag` is a feature flag a release configuration switches on;
#   * `:g10_keyword_flag` is a feature flag a release configuration switches on with the
#     keyword form of the directive;
#   * `:g10_secret` is a secret read with a literal default;
#   * `:g10_runtime_key` is read while the code is compiled but registered as a runtime read;
#   * `:g10_stale` is registered but nobody reads it;
#   * `:g10_guard` is a guard whose registry default is not on;
#   * `:g10_malformed` does not have the ten columns of the registry;
#   * `:g10_url` names a validator that is not a module of the tree;
#   * `:g10_startup_url` names a validator that is not a validation at all.
#
# `G10_UNREGISTERED_SETTING`, `G10_LIST_SETTING`, `G10_ATTRIBUTE_SETTING`, `G10_LOCAL_SETTING`
# and `G10_ENV_MAP_SETTING` are read by the fixture and are deliberately absent here: they are
# the five forms a variable can be named in, and each of them has to be reported.
app_env|:letflow:g10_flag_enabled|platform|platform|runtime|flag|false|no|none|A fixture flag that is read with a default that turns it on.
app_env|:letflow:g10_release_flag|platform|platform|runtime|flag|false|no|none|A fixture flag that a release configuration switches on.
app_env|:letflow:g10_keyword_flag|platform|platform|runtime|flag|false|no|none|A fixture flag that a release configuration switches on with the keyword form of the directive.
app_env|:letflow:g10_secret|platform|platform|runtime|secret|none|yes|none|A fixture secret that is read with a literal default.
app_env|:letflow:g10_runtime_key|platform|platform|runtime|plain|none|no|none|A fixture key that is read while the code is compiled.
app_env|:letflow:g10_stale|platform|platform|runtime|plain|none|no|none|A fixture key nobody reads.
app_env|:letflow:g10_guard|platform|platform|runtime|guard|false|no|none|A fixture guard whose registry default is not on.
app_env|:letflow:g10_url|platform|platform|runtime|url|none|no|Letflow.NoSuchValidator|A fixture URL whose validator is not a module of the tree.
app_env|:letflow:g10_startup_url|platform|platform|runtime|url|none|no|startup|A fixture URL whose validator names no validation at all.
app_env|:letflow:g10_malformed|platform|platform|runtime|plain
